headline: 49ers place starting DT C.J. West on IR due to knee injury
summary: 49ers defensive tackle C.J. West, who is going to miss at least a chunk of the season with a bone chip in his knee that will require surgery, was placed on injured reserve Wednesday.

headline: Seahawks' Macdonald apologizes to Broncos' Payton for comments
summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday he called Broncos coach Sean Payton and apologized for comments he made in a published video that went viral Tuesday.

headline: Justin Herbert disputes perception of lack of vocal leadership
summary: Something has kept Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert from fulfilling a skillset that has had coach Jim Harbaugh proclaim that Herbert will be regarded as the best to ever play the game.
